given_when_then.given: A Platform Operator initiates the creation of a new delivery zone
given_when_then.when: The geographic boundaries of the new zone overlap with a restricted zone defined by the Regulatory Authority
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request to create the Service Area Definition

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner attempts to place an order from a location within a deactivated Service Area Definition
given_when_then.when: The system validates the customer's address against current Service Area Definitions
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the Order Request and displays a message indicating delivery is not available

given_when_then.given: A Platform Operator modifies an active Service Area Definition
given_when_then.when: The operator submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system logs the modification with the reason for change and the identity of the operator

success_criteria: The system prevents the creation of a Service Area Definition if its geographic boundaries overlap with a restricted zone defined by the Regulatory Authority
The system rejects any new Order Request originating from a deactivated Service Area Definition
The system logs every modification to an active Service Area Definition including the reason for change and the identity of the operator
